name: Yingshanosaurus
sum: Yingshanosaurus is a medium-sized stegosaur from the Middle Jurassic Upper Shaximiao Formation of Sichuan, China, known from a partial skeleton.
wsnote: Range given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: A partially articulated skeleton from Yingshan County, Sichuan, including dorsal vertebrae, pelvis, tail, left forelimb and hindlimb, and five osteoderms (plates and a shoulder spine).
biology: Like other stegosaurs it was a slow-moving quadrupedal herbivore.
author: Zhou 1986
